request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:RAIDER

layers.text: Recolour only the dark blue-grey hide: it becomes a clearer, lighter steel blue, colour #5578aa on the lit side, the shadow only a little darker, colour #334c78, with dark navy only along the top of the back and tail. Do not redraw anything. Keep the amber-orange crest, the cream belly, throat and claws, the eyes, teeth, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
